author: Muse (port)
Firch (original mod)
description: Fifty-one Jokers, both exotic suits, the Spectrum-family poker hands (Spectrum, Straight Spectrum, Spectrum House, Spectrum Five) plus Deal, and six consumables ported from Bunco by Firch. The v1.1.0 additions need the Balatro3DS fork's Tier 1 + Tier 2 mod APIs (create/destroy cards, retrigger returns, SMODS.Suit, SMODS.PokerHand) and the fork's suit-pool gate for random card fronts.
name: Bunco Pack
